ValidationRule.description: Required fields upon creation: Billing & Shipping Address; City; Zip Code
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(IsPersonAccount), OR( ISBLANK(BillingStreet), ISBLANK(BillingCity), ISBLANK(BillingPostalCode), ISBLANK(ShippingAddress), ISBLANK(ShippingCity), ISBLANK(ShippingPostalCode) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Billing and Shipping Address info are required.
